introduction: Video excerpt from the Vietnam Wars video

vocabulary.example: The escalation of tensions between the two countries led to a full-blown conflict.

vocabulary.definition: to keep away from; to prevent from happening
vocabulary.example: The pilot tried to avoid the storm by changing course.

vocabulary.definition: related to a plan of action designed to achieve a particular goal
vocabulary.example: The company discussed their strategic approach to entering the new market.

vocabulary.definition: a member of a small independent group taking part in irregular fighting, typically against larger regular forces
vocabulary.example: The guerrilla fighters launched a surprise attack on the enemy camp.

vocabulary.definition: fought or done with great energy and determination
vocabulary.example: The team engaged in a pitched battle to secure their place in the finals.

vocabulary.definition: a highly flammable sticky jelly used in incendiary bombs and flamethrowers
vocabulary.example: The soldiers used napalm to destroy enemy supply lines in the dense forest.
